title: Harden and execute the 143-capability current-host Evidence Registry closure and global promotion reconciliation
decisions: A capability PASS requires a cryptographically attributable current-host receipt bound to its canonical positive, negative and rollback test identifiers.
CI/reference PASS cannot be used as current-host runtime PASS.
Synthetic evidence cannot be promoted as production current-host evidence.
Component-scope PASS, including HRB-CUDA, remains valid but cannot substitute for the 143 capability closure.
Evidence Registry reconciliation may promote only records whose receipts satisfy the hardened validator.
Global PROMOTED remains fail-closed until 143/143 runtime evidence, 19/19 Acceptance Gate, mandatory Terax current-host gate, independent review and human promotion receipt are all PASS.
